benefit_text: The scheme pays 300 rupees per month to widows between 40 years and 79 years. The scheme pays 500 rupees per month to persons who are 80 years and above.
who_can_apply: Widows in the age group of 40 to 79 years can apply. Widows must belong to a household living below the poverty line.
documents: The papers are death certificate of husband with name of widow. BPL card is needed. Age proof like birth certificate or school certificate is needed.
how_to_apply: People use UMANG App and search for NSAP. People login with mobile number and OTP. People fill basic details and upload photo and submit.
